mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.8% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing inflationary pressure and increasing the likelihood of future monetary easing, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.8% for two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units in two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and a contraction in residential investment, which triggers a reassessment of economic growth prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500 for two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 98.5 index points for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, increasing the risk of recession and reducing corporate earnings expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.5 for two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based collapse in consumer demand for durable goods and housing, which increases the probability of a near-term economic slowdown and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline simultaneously, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 275) and a persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signals a delayed monetary policy response to inflation, increasing the risk of future rate hikes and equity market volatility, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 275 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS > 148,000) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals a strong labor market recovery, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 148000 and UNRATE < 4.5%, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1 > 19400) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST > 1550) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which increases corporate revenue expectations and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 19400 and HOUST > 1550, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
